answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 952 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the glacier. The basalt index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the karst queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier still earns. The deposit is 36 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
